senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; דקק)thin, fine, tender, opp. גַּס.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:1">Ḥull. III, 1</cite> <he>עוף הד׳</he> small fowl (doves, birds &c.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 6:7">Ib. VI, 7</cite> <he>זבל הד׳</he> powdered ordure, <he>חול הד׳</he> fine sand; a. fr.—Pl. <he>דַּקִּים</he>, <he>דַּקִּין</he>.
Ib. III, 1; a. fr. הד׳ the small bowels.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:3:18">Y. Ber. II, 4ᵈ</cite> top <he>בדקים</he> (sub. <he>נקבים</he>) concerning the smaller functions of the body (urinizing, usu. <he>קטנים</he>), opp. <he>גסים</he> (usu. <he>גדולים</he>), v. <cite ref="C00180"><he>גָּדוֹל</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 2:2">Kel. II, 2</cite> <he>הד׳ שבכלי חרס</he> the fine and small earthen vessels; a. fr.—Fem. <cite ref="D00994"><he>דַּקָּה</he></cite>. (<cite ref="B00182"><he>בהמה</he></cite>) <he>ד׳</he>, small cattle, v. <cite ref="C00514"><he>גַּס</he></cite>. Ḥull. l. c.
Ib. 80ᵃ חיה ד׳ small forest animals (deer, fox &c.). בד׳ (sub. מדה) in small quantities, retail.
<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 2:5">Dem. II, 5</cite>; Y. ib. 23ᵃ bot.; <cite ref="Tosefta Demai 3:12">Tosef. ib. III, 12</cite>, v. <cite ref="L00286"><he>לוּמָּא</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 4:4">Yoma IV, 4</cite> <he>ד׳</he> powdered frank incense, <he>ד׳ מן הד׳</he> the very finest; a. fr.—Pl. <he>דַּקּוֹת</he>.
